SongNodes: Architecture Enhancements, Critical Gaps & Proposed Modules
{SVG_COMMON_DEFS}
Enhanced Architecture: Critical Data Gaps & Proposed Single-Purpose Modules Identification of 5 critical architectural vulnerabilities alongside 4 proposed lightweight modules (<500 LOC) and unified storage backbone
Identified Architectural Gaps (Missing Feedback Loops & Latencies)
GAP-01 (High): Disconnected Rekordbox Booth Performance Feedback Loop Sets export to Rekordbox XML, but live CDJ playback logs (HISTORY.m3u8) never feed back into SongNodes.
Current: USB performance logs are abandoned on flash drive after gigs. Impact: Live proven transitions do not increment occurrence_count; rotation decay is uncalibrated. Fix: Deploy MOD-01 Booth History Ingester (services/library/booth_history.py)
GAP-02 (High): Dual Storage Disconnect (PostgreSQL library.* vs SQLite dj_library.sqlite) Weekly script writes to SQLite; SongNodes web app writes to PostgreSQL. Only a static JSON is copied.
Current: Curator tag edits or crate changes in web UI do not propagate back to weekly SQLite ledger. Impact: Split-brain library state; risk of overwriting user tags during Sunday weekly pipeline runs. Fix: Deploy MOD-03 Bi-Directional Library Bridge (services/library/bridge.py)
GAP-03 (Medium): Missing Audio Fingerprint & AcoustID Transition Segmenter Transitions rely strictly on text tracklists. Recorded live audio mixes cannot be automatically segmented.
Current: Un-tracklisted DJ sets and radio broadcasts cannot be mined for transitions. Impact: Track versions (Dub vs VIP) cannot be validated against audio acoustic waveforms. Fix: Deploy Essentia / Chromaprint Segmenter worker for automated transition discovery.
GAP-04 (Medium): Unwired Scraper Target Queue Scheduling Curators add target artists in /library or /sources/targets, but musicLibrary pipeline ignores the queue.
Current: musicLibrary pipeline reads static config/sources.json and does not poll target_tracks. Impact: High-priority targets added by user sit idle until manually dispatched in SongNodes. Fix: Wire ML-TASK-03 cron script synchronising PostgreSQL target_tracks to weekly runner.
GAP-05 (Low): Outbox Projection Lag Invisibility in Web Client Graph projection polls every 15 seconds; bulk scraping induces temporary projection lag without UI indicator.
Current: /paths and /library show stale data during ingestion bursts with no freshness warning. Impact: Selectors may query paths that omit transitions currently pending in the projection queue. Fix: Deploy MOD-02 Realtime Graph Outbox Daemon with SSE lag push to UI.
Proposed Solutions: 4 Single-Purpose Modules (<500 LOC) & Storage Backbone
MOD-01: Booth History Ingester (services/library/booth_history.py) Target Users: Performing DJ, Music Curator · 1 Verb: Harvest · ~340 LOC · Conforms to Design System
Inputs: Pioneer DJ HISTORY.m3u8, USB play logs, gig venue/date metadata Core Operation: Parses chronological playback timestamps, matches track IDs against silver tracks, increments silver_track_transitions occurrence count, and advances rotation decay timers. Contract: BoothHistoryIngestContract {venue, date, transitions: [{from_id, to_id, played_at}]}
MOD-02: Realtime Graph Outbox Daemon (services/graph-projection/sync_daemon.py) Target Users: Platform Admin, Graph Specialist · 1 Verb: Stream · ~280 LOC
Inputs: PostgreSQL LISTEN/NOTIFY events on silver_track_transitions outbox Core Operation: Replaces 15-second polling loop with sub-second reactive Bolt connection, streaming verified transition pairs directly into Memgraph graph topology. Contract: OutboxStreamEvent {transition_id, source_id, target_id, occurrences, weight}
MOD-03: Bi-Directional Library Bridge (services/library/bridge.py) Target Users: Music Curator, Data Engineer · 1 Verb: Reconcile · ~410 LOC
Inputs: PostgreSQL library.* schema, SQLite dj_library.sqlite, music-library.json Core Operation: Enforces atomic single-writer distributed lease, computes table SHA-256 checksums, and replicates curator tag adjustments two-way with zero data loss. Contract: LibrarySyncContract {version, checksum_sha256, reconciled_at, mutations: [...]}
MOD-04: Audio Preview Caching Proxy (services/rest_api/routers/audio_cache.py) Target Users: Performing DJ, Live Selector · 1 Verb: Cache · ~290 LOC
Inputs: Deezer / TIDAL 30s audio preview URLs Core Operation: Caches audio snippets locally on disk; serves immediate audio streams for offline booth. Contract: AudioCacheResponse {track_id, cached: bool, stream_url: '/audio/cache/{id}.mp3'}
Proposed Unified Storage Backbone Directory Architecture Replaces fragmented directories across E:\musicLibrary and SongNodes with structured volume hierarchy
/var/songnodes/ bronze/ (JSONL)
/var/songnodes/ silver/ (Ledger)
/var/songnodes/ library/ (SQLite)
/var/songnodes/ audio/ (30s MP3)
/var/songnodes/ exports/ (XML/CSV)
SongNodes Enhanced Architecture · 5 Critical Gaps · 4 Targeted Modules (<500 LOC) · Unified Storage Directory Backbone · Melbourne Australia
